# wgpu-native

This project includes the official Linux x86_64 release of wgpu-native v29.0.1.1
for native WebGPU compute. The release archive SHA-256 is
`7e67d7445c42aeb85e30f88930fd8d7d83ee769e3390aeb1ada75ebf3cf78132`.
